def forward(groups):
    date, sp1, time = groups
    text = date + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    date = dt.strftime('%y/%m/%d')
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    return date + (' ' * sp1_len) + time

def forward(groups):
    sp1, whole, frac, sp2, unit = groups
    unit_code = {'KB': 1, 'GB': 2}.get(unit, 0)
    return {'stored': [int(whole) * 10 + int(frac)], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), unit_code]}

def inverse(record):
    v = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = layout[0]
    sp2_len = layout[1]
    unit_code = layout[2]
    unit_names = {1: 'KB', 2: 'GB'}
    whole = v // 10
    frac = v % 10
    return 'free' + (' ' * sp1_len) + str(whole) + '.' + str(frac) + (' ' * sp2_len) + unit_names[unit_code]
